# Verification reports

Release evidence for the action-verification gate
([docs/VERIFICATION.md](../VERIFICATION.md)): one directory per release tag,
one sub-directory per OS the gate ran on — `REPORT.md` (build + OS + the full
certificate) and `verification.json` (machine copy). Produced by
`node scripts/verify.mjs --release <tag>` on the tagged commit; the release
workflow refuses to publish a tag without a green report here, and links the
report in the release notes.
